parent_objective: design R4 mitigation severity instrumentation before any role-family comparison
blocked_by: R4 impact speed delta-v collision angle post-event and recoverability fields are absent
mitigation performance cannot be claimed from proxy fields
current measured execution artifacts need instrumentation before R4 comparison
supersedes: direct R4 controller comparison without severity fields

public_gates: M2326 must map each required R4 mitigation field to an instrumentation source or explicit unavailable status
M2326 must preserve the P0 human-view no-wheel no-oracle actor contract
M2326 must not change reward or training objective
M2326 must not run reset rollout measured execution training replay PPO private holdout ranking or paper/self-ID claims
forbidden_shortcuts: do not rank support policies or controller families
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not claim residual support solved
do not claim mitigation performance from proxy metrics alone
do not add any mitigation field to actor input

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: turns the accepted R4 metric availability gap into a concrete instrumentation plan
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no rerun ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if the design changes actor input reward or training objective
stop if it routes directly to controller ranking
stop if required fields cannot be sourced or explicitly marked unavailable
stop if mitigation performance is claimed from proxy metrics
fallback_plan: route to current-sim metric-source audit if instrumentation points are unclear
route to R2/R3/R5 coverage-vs-redesign branch if R4 instrumentation is impossible in current sim
route to branch synthesis if the design cannot produce an implementation manifest
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: new R4 mitigation instrumentation branch starts at M2326

training_stage.stage_objective: freeze R4 mitigation metric instrumentation design
admission_evidence: M2325 accepts M2324 R4 metric availability gap
allowed_updates: M2326 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up implementation manifest selected by the design
next_stage_criteria: each required R4 metric has a source or explicit unavailable status
implementation scope is bounded to logging/measurement artifacts
actor input contract and reward are unchanged

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2326 designs metric instrumentation and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2326; no wrong-history reset-hidden or zero-history intervention is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M2324 R4 mitigation metric availability artifacts.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: R4 metric gaps must not be interpreted as self-ID failure.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking paper-level result finite-window-vs-GRU conclusion or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: adds missing measurement capability required by scenario/task-quality evidence
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can make R4 mitigation measurable before current-sim controller comparison
must_synthesize_if: the R4 mitigation instrumentation branch reaches 10 milestones without synthesis

hypothesis: A bounded design can specify R4 mitigation severity instrumentation without changing actor input reward or training.
success_criteria: all required R4 fields are mapped to a source or unavailable status
the design forbids adding mitigation fields to actor input
the design selects a bounded implementation route
failure_criteria: M2326 starts new training reset rollout measured execution replay PPO or private holdout
M2326 ranks support policies or selects a winner
M2326 changes actor input reward or training objective
M2326 makes finite-window-vs-GRU paper-level or level3 self-ID claims
M2326 cannot select a next route

commands.name: design
commands.command: manual instrumentation design from M2324 metric availability artifacts and measured execution code inspection

decision_rule: M2326 passes if it freezes a bounded R4 metric instrumentation design and selects an implementation route.
